# PressController

> Handles pointer and keyboard press interactions, dispatching `native:press` events.

## Constructor

```ts
new PressController(host: HTMLElement, options?: PressOptions)
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Required | Description |
|--------|------|----------|-------------|
| `disabled` | `boolean | (() => boolean)` | no |  |

## Events Dispatched

| Event | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| `native:press` | `{ pointerType }` |

## Methods

| Method | Parameters | Returns |
|--------|------------|---------|
| `attach()` | `—` | `void` |
| `detach()` | `—` | `void` |
| `destroy()` | `—` | `void` |

## Usage

```ts
import { PressController } from '@nonoun/native-ui';
const ctrl = new PressController(element, { /* options */ });
// In teardown: ctrl.destroy();
```
